desc: Scan for security issues: hardcoded secrets, unsanitised input to LLMs, and missing auth checks
context: Review app/api/** for: (1) hardcoded API keys, tokens, or credentials; (2) user-controlled input passed directly to LLM prompts without sanitisation; (3) endpoints missing authentication/authorisation guards. Cross-reference app/auth/ to understand the auth patterns in use.
acceptance_criteria: All 9 API files scanned for secrets and unsanitised input
Any security issues documented with file:line evidence
Auth coverage assessed for each endpoint group
Severity-rated findings ready for assertion-backed report
